name: query.actor_count
description: Always 1. Exists for compatibility with Bedrock animations.

name: query.blocking
description: Whether the entity is blocking with a shield.

name: query.body_x_rotation
description: The entity's pitch in degrees.

name: query.body_y_rotation
description: The body yaw in degrees. For entities without a separate body rotation this is the view yaw.

name: query.cardinal_facing
description: The direction the entity faces as a number: 0 down, 1 up, 2 north, 3 south, 4 west, 5 east.

name: query.cardinal_facing_2d
description: Like cardinal_facing, but up and down are reported as 6, so only the four horizontal directions remain.

name: query.cardinal_player_facing
description: The direction the entity faces, using the same numbers as cardinal_facing.

name: query.day
description: The number of in-game days that have passed, with the time of day as the fraction.

name: query.death_ticks
description: Ticks since the entity died. 0 while alive.

name: query.distance_from_camera
description: Always 0. Exists for compatibility with Bedrock animations.

name: query.equipment_count
description: How many armor slots are filled.

name: query.frame_alpha
description: The progress between the last and the next tick, from 0 to 1. Useful for smooth motion.

name: query.get_actor_info_id
description: The entity's numeric ID in the current world.

name: query.ground_speed
description: The horizontal speed in blocks per tick.

name: query.has_cape
description: Whether the player has a cape that is visible.

name: query.has_collision
description: Whether the entity collides with blocks.

name: query.has_gravity
description: Whether the entity is affected by gravity.

name: query.has_head_gear
description: Whether something is worn in the head slot.

name: query.has_owner
description: Whether the entity is tamed or otherwise owned.

name: query.has_player_rider
description: Whether a player is riding the entity.

name: query.has_rider
description: Whether anything is riding the entity.

name: query.head_x_rotation
description: The head pitch in degrees. Negative when looking up.

name: query.head_y_rotation
description: The head yaw in degrees, in world space.

name: query.health
description: The current health.

name: query.hurt_time
description: Counts down from 10 after the entity took damage. 0 when not hurt.

name: query.invulnerable_ticks
description: Remaining ticks of damage immunity after getting hurt.

name: query.is_alive
description: Whether the entity is alive.

name: query.is_angry
description: Whether a neutral mob, like a wolf or enderman, is angry.

name: query.is_baby
description: Whether the entity is a baby.

name: query.is_breathing
description: Whether the entity's air supply is full.

name: query.is_fire_immune
description: Whether the entity type is immune to fire.

name: query.is_first_person
description: Whether the entity is the local player viewed in first person.

name: query.is_in_contact_with_water
description: Whether the entity is in water or standing in rain.

name: query.is_in_lava
description: Whether the entity is in lava.

name: query.is_in_water
description: Whether the entity is in water.

name: query.is_in_water_or_rain
description: Whether the entity is in water or standing in rain.

name: query.is_invisible
description: Whether the entity is invisible.

name: query.is_leashed
description: Whether the entity is on a lead.

name: query.is_moving
description: Whether the entity moved since the last tick.

name: query.is_on_fire
description: Whether the entity is burning.

name: query.is_on_ground
description: Whether the entity stands on the ground.

name: query.is_riding
description: Whether the entity is riding something.

name: query.is_saddled
description: Whether the entity wears a saddle.

name: query.is_silent
description: Whether the entity is silent.

name: query.is_sleeping
description: Whether the entity is sleeping in a bed.

name: query.is_sneaking
description: Whether the entity is crouching.

name: query.is_sprinting
description: Whether the entity is sprinting.

name: query.is_swimming
description: Whether the entity is swimming.

name: query.is_using_item
description: Whether the entity is using an item, like eating or drawing a bow.

name: query.is_wall_climbing
description: Whether the entity is on a ladder, vine or another climbable block. For Palladium's wall climbing ability use palladium.is_wall_climbing.

name: query.life_time
description: Always 0. Exists for compatibility with Bedrock animations.

name: query.limb_swing
description: How far the legs have swung in the walking animation. Grows continuously while walking.

name: query.limb_swing_amount
description: How strongly the walking animation plays, from 0 when standing still to about 1 when running.

name: query.main_hand_item_max_duration
description: How many ticks the item in the main hand can be used for, like a bow's draw time.

name: query.main_hand_item_use_duration
description: How long the item in the main hand has been used, in seconds. 0 when it is not being used.

name: query.max_health
description: The maximum health.

name: query.moon_brightness
description: The current brightness of the stars, from 0 during the day to 1 at night.

name: query.moon_phase
description: The moon phase, from 0 (full moon) to 7.

name: query.movement_direction
description: The direction the entity is moving in, using the same numbers as cardinal_facing. 6 when not moving.

name: query.player_level
description: The player's experience level. 0 for other entities.

name: query.rider_body_x_rotation
description: The pitch of the first rider in degrees. 0 without a rider.

name: query.rider_body_y_rotation
description: The body yaw of the first rider in degrees. 0 without a rider.

name: query.rider_head_x_rotation
description: The head pitch of the first rider in degrees. 0 without a rider.

name: query.rider_head_y_rotation
description: The head yaw of the first rider in degrees. 0 without a rider.

name: query.scale
description: The entity's scale, for example from the scale attribute. 1 by default.

name: query.sleep_rotation
description: The yaw of the bed the entity sleeps in, in degrees. 0 when not sleeping.

name: query.time_of_day
description: The time of day from 0 to 1. 0 is sunrise, 0.25 noon, 0.5 sunset and 0.75 midnight.

name: query.time_stamp
description: The total game time in ticks.

name: query.vertical_speed
description: The vertical speed in blocks per tick. Positive when moving up.

name: query.yaw_speed
description: How far the yaw changed since the last tick, in degrees.
